name: When should I replace my kitchen cabinets instead of painting or repairing them?

mainEntity.name: When should I replace my kitchen cabinets instead of painting or repairing them?

acceptedAnswer.text: Full cabinet replacement is necessary when the existing cabinet boxes suffer from structural damage, persistent moisture rot, or severe sagging that cannot hold countertop weight. You should also replace your cabinets if you want to modify your kitchen layout, add an island, or install differently sized appliances. Refinishing or repainting works well for solid wood boxes with minor surface wear, but it will not resolve broken particleboard, warped frames, or inadequate storage configurations. Replacing the units gives you a durable, level foundation for long-term daily use.
acceptedAnswer.description: Replace cabinets when the internal boxes have structural or water damage, when shelves sag, or when you want to change your kitchen layout and appliance placement.
